# Professional, elegant color palette (vibrant but slightly muted)
refined_palette = {
    "Very Low": "#3b8ea5",     # rich teal blue
    "Low": "#7ec4cf",          # soft muted aqua
    "Moderate": "#f4d35e",     # sophisticated yellow-gold
    "High": "#ee964b",         # warm muted orange
    "Very High": "#d1495b"     # elegant deep red
}
# Prettify category names
category_labels = {
    "national_failures": "National Failures",
    "weak_systems": "Weak Systems",
    "making_progress": "Making Progress",
    "missing_key_laws": "Missing Key Laws",
    "national_leader": "National Leader"
}

# Vibrant, exciting palette (high-contrast but tasteful)
vibrant_palette = {
    "national_failures": "#d73027",  # vivid red
    "weak_systems": "#fc8d59",       # bright coral
    "making_progress": "#fee08b",    # golden yellow
    "missing_key_laws": "#91bfdb",   # light vibrant blue
    "national_leader": "#4575b4"     # deep vivid blue
}

# Ensure order
merged_data['gun_law_strength'] = pd.Categorical(
    merged_data['gun_law_strength'], 
    categories=["national_failures", "weak_systems", "making_progress", "missing_key_laws", "national_leader"],
    ordered=True
)

plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

ax = sns.boxplot(
    x="gun_law_strength",
    y="firearm_mortality_by_state_2022",
    data=merged_data,
    order=["national_failures", "weak_systems", "making_progress", "missing_key_laws", "national_leader"],
    palette=vibrant_palette,
    linewidth=1.8,
    fliersize=3,
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.9, linewidth=1.5),
    whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    capprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    medianprops=dict(color="black", linewidth=2)
)

# Update the tick labels to proper format without rotation
ax.set_xticklabels([category_labels[label.get_text()] for label in ax.get_xticklabels()], fontsize=13)

# Labeling
plt.xlabel("Gun Law Strength Category", fontsize=15, labelpad=10)
plt.ylabel("Firearm Mortality Rate (2022)", fontsize=15, labelpad=10)
plt.title("Firearm Mortality Rates by Gun Law Strength", fontsize=20, weight='bold', pad=20)

# Subtle gridlines
plt.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.25)

# Add median annotations on each box
medians = merged_data.groupby("gun_law_strength")["firearm_mortality_by_state_2022"].median()
for i, median in enumerate(medians):
    ax.text(i, median + 0.5, f"{median:.1f}", ha='center', fontsize=11, weight='bold', color="black")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Define bins and categories (if not already done)
bins = [0, 10, 15, 20, 25, merged_data['firearm_mortality_by_state_2022'].max()]
labels = ["Very Low", "Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High"]
merged_data['mortality_category'] = pd.cut(
    merged_data['firearm_mortality_by_state_2022'], bins=bins, labels=labels
)

# Vibrant eye-catching palette (progressing from cool green to deep red-purple)

    "Very High": "#d00000"     # deep red
}
